name: VC Dimension of Repeated-Coordinate Cubes
proof: One fixed copy of the first bit together with $x_2,\ldots,x_n$ realizes the full n-cube, so VC is at least n. The class has exactly $2^n$ distinct concepts; shattering d coordinates requires $2^d$ distinct traces, so d<=n. Thus VC equals n.
references: Local definition-driven proof; bounded independent replay in sync/verify_noclashing_antichain_gap.py.
